content.short: BLOCKLORDS is a play-to-own medieval MMO grand strategy game built on Immutable X and Polygon.
content.description: BLOCKLORDS is a medieval MMO grand strategy game built on Immutable X and Polygon that embraces a play-to-own model. Players steer their journey and assets through a dynamic hero system, with decisions shaping development and encouraging asset retention over resale. You grow, gather, trade, and form alliances to strengthen your kingdom. Choose your path—live as a farmer or wage war on neighboring realms. Every BLOCKLORDS hero has unique traits and can be upgraded, letting you craft your own distinctive experience.
